name: aj-house-rules
description: aj's Claude Code tools. house-rules enforces the global CLAUDE.md rules as hooks on every device and in every project; prompt-workshop and agent-router are newer offshoots of the same plugin formula, both still shells (see docs/offshoots-plan.md).

plugins.name: house-rules
plugins.description: Enforces aj's global CLAUDE.md rules as hooks: no hidden background work, no unasked git mutations, no unchecked destructive commands.

plugins.name: prompt-workshop
plugins.description: STATUS: shell/v0.1. Notices an under-specified prompt and walks the user through goal, constraints, success criteria and gating before Claude runs with an inferred reading of it.

plugins.name: agent-router
plugins.description: STATUS: shell/v0.1. Classifies each prompt's complexity and nudges Claude to delegate to a model-pinned subagent - haiku for simple doc/comms work, sonnet for recon and code implementation, opus for planning, architecture, and management. Cannot switch the live session's own model.
